# API

`nbpdns serve` serves its API at `/api`, on `server.listen`. This page is
generated from `api/openapi.yaml`, the API's source of truth, version 1.1.0.
The service serves the same document at `/api/openapi.yaml`, and a
reference to browse at `/api/docs`.
[How nbpdns's API is designed](../explanation/how-nbpdns-api-is-designed.md)
explains its conventions.

> [!WARNING]
> The API has no authentication until M10, and it names your server
> groups, zones, and records. Keep `server.listen` on a trusted network.
> Only NetBox's webhooks need a signature.

## Conventions

- Bodies are JSON, with `snake_case` fields. Every field that a
  response's schema lists is always present: one with nothing to say is
  `null`.
- Times are RFC 3339, in UTC.
- A list takes `limit`, from 1 to 1000, 100 by default, and `cursor`, and
  answers a page: its `items`, and the absolute URLs of itself, `self`,
  and of the next page, `next`, which is `null` on the last page.
- Every error is an RFC 9457 problem, as `application/problem+json`.
- Each request may send an `X-Flow-ID`; the response returns it, or a
  new one, which is the request's `request_id` in the logs.

## Operations

### `GET /api/status`

Get the service's status. Operation `getStatus`.

Returns the service's build, uptime, readiness and liveness, the refresh schedule and how the last refresh went, NetBox's state, and where spans are exported. Each server group's state is a resource of its own, under `/server-groups`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Flow-ID` | header | `string` | The request's flow ID, to follow it through the logs. A request without a valid one is given one. Either way, the response returns it, and it's the request's `request_id` in nbpdns's logs. |

| Response | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The service's status. | [`Status`](#status), `application/json` |
| default | Any other error. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |

### `GET /api/server-groups`

List the server groups. Operation `listServerGroups`.

Returns a page of the server groups, in the configuration's order, each with its last-known state.

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Flow-ID` | header | `string` | The request's flow ID, to follow it through the logs. A request without a valid one is given one. Either way, the response returns it, and it's the request's `request_id` in nbpdns's logs. |
| `limit` | query | `integer` (`int32`) | The most items the page may have. |
| `cursor` | query | `string` | Where the page starts: a previous page's `next` link carries it. It's opaque, and only good with the same filters as the page that gave it. |

| Response | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | A page of server groups. | [`ServerGroupPage`](#servergrouppage), `application/json` |
| 400 | A parameter is invalid, such as a limit out of range, or a cursor that this API didn't give. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |
| default | Any other error. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |

### `GET /api/server-groups/{group}`

Get a server group. Operation `getServerGroup`.

Returns one server group, with its last-known state.

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Flow-ID` | header | `string` | The request's flow ID, to follow it through the logs. A request without a valid one is given one. Either way, the response returns it, and it's the request's `request_id` in nbpdns's logs. |
| `group` | path, required | `string` | The server group's name. |

| Response | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The server group. | [`ServerGroup`](#servergroup), `application/json` |
| 404 | No such resource. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |
| default | Any other error. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |

### `GET /api/server-groups/{group}/zones`

List a server group's zones. Operation `listZones`.

Returns a page of the zones of a server group, as of its last successful read, in canonical name order: the zones NetBox assigns to it, and, with the state `unmanaged`, the zones on its primary that NetBox doesn't. A group never read has none, and `as_of` is null.

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Flow-ID` | header | `string` | The request's flow ID, to follow it through the logs. A request without a valid one is given one. Either way, the response returns it, and it's the request's `request_id` in nbpdns's logs. |
| `group` | path, required | `string` | The server group's name. |
| `state` | query | array of [`ZoneState`](#zonestate) | Only the zones in these states, such as `drift,missing`. The drifted states are `drift`, `missing` and `inactive_in_netbox`. |
| `limit` | query | `integer` (`int32`) | The most items the page may have. |
| `cursor` | query | `string` | Where the page starts: a previous page's `next` link carries it. It's opaque, and only good with the same filters as the page that gave it. |

| Response | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | A page of the group's zones. | [`ZonePage`](#zonepage), `application/json` |
| 400 | A parameter is invalid, such as a limit out of range, or a cursor that this API didn't give. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |
| 404 | No such resource. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |
| default | Any other error. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |

### `GET /api/server-groups/{group}/zones/{zone}`

| 404 | No such resource. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |
| default | Any other error. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |

| `limit` | query | `integer` (`int32`) | The most items the page may have. |
| `cursor` | query | `string` | Where the page starts: a previous page's `next` link carries it. It's opaque, and only good with the same filters as the page that gave it. |

### `GET /api/server-groups/{group}/zones/{zone}/rrsets`

List a zone's RRsets, as NetBox defines them. Operation `listZoneRRsets`.

Returns a page of a zone's RRsets as NetBox defines them, in nbpdns's normalized form, as of NetBox's last successful read: what nbpdns compares with the group's primary, so what a client can publish elsewhere. Only active records are listed. The zone is the one in the group's NetBox views, the first by view name if several views have it. RRsets come in canonical order: by owner name, then the SOA, then NS, then the other types.

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Flow-ID` | header | `string` | The request's flow ID, to follow it through the logs. A request without a valid one is given one. Either way, the response returns it, and it's the request's `request_id` in nbpdns's logs. |
| `group` | path, required | `string` | The server group's name. |
| `zone` | path, required | `string` | The zone's name, with or without its final dot, such as `example.com`. Internationalized names are given in their ASCII form, such as `xn--bcher-kva.example`. |
| `limit` | query | `integer` (`int32`) | The most items the page may have. |
| `cursor` | query | `string` | Where the page starts: a previous page's `next` link carries it. It's opaque, and only good with the same filters as the page that gave it. |

| Response | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | A page of the zone's RRsets. | [`RRsetPage`](#rrsetpage), `application/json` |
| 400 | A parameter is invalid, such as a limit out of range, or a cursor that this API didn't give. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |
| 404 | No such resource. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |
| default | Any other error. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |

### `POST /api/netbox-events`

Receive a NetBox webhook. Operation `receiveNetBoxEvent`.

Receives an event from a NetBox event rule's webhook, signed with `netbox.webhook_secret`, and queues a refresh of the zones it names, which runs once no event has come for `drift.webhook_delay`. A record's event names its zone, and a zone's event the zone, and its old name if it was renamed. A view's event, a zone moved to another view, a record moved to another zone, and more than 100 zones at once each make a full refresh instead. Events for other object types, and zones in views that no server group serves, are accepted and ignored. The endpoint is off until `netbox.webhook_secret` is set.

Needs the `X-Hook-Signature` header. It's the hex HMAC-SHA512 of the request's body, keyed by `netbox.webhook_secret`, as a NetBox webhook sends it when its secret is set.

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Flow-ID` | header | `string` | The request's flow ID, to follow it through the logs. A request without a valid one is given one. Either way, the response returns it, and it's the request's `request_id` in nbpdns's logs. |

The request's body is [`NetBoxEvent`](#netboxevent), `application/json`. It's the event, as NetBox's webhook sends it without a body template.

| Response | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 202 | The event is accepted. The refresh it asks for runs later, if it asks for one. | none |
| 400 | The body isn't an event that NetBox sends, such as JSON without an `object_type`. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |
| 401 | The request's `X-Hook-Signature` is missing, or isn't the body's, keyed by `netbox.webhook_secret`. Nothing in the body is read. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |
| 404 | Webhooks are off, because `netbox.webhook_secret` isn't set. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |
| 413 | The body is over 1 MiB, which no event that nbpdns reads needs. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |
| default | Any other error. | [`Problem`](#problem), `application/problem+json` |

## Schemas

### `Problem`

An error, as RFC 9457 describes it.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` (`uri-reference`) | The kind of problem. `about:blank` means the status code says it all. |
| `title` | `string` | A short summary of the kind of problem. |
| `status` | `integer` (`int32`) | The response's HTTP status code. |
| `detail` | `string`, or null | What went wrong with this request, or null. |
| `instance` | `string` (`uri-reference`), or null | The path of the request that had the problem, or null. |

### `Status`

The nbpdns service's state.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | `string` | The build's version. |
| `revision` | `string` | The build's Git commit. |
| `started` | `string` (`date-time`) | When the service started. |
| `uptime_seconds` | `number` (`double`) | The time since the service started. |
| `ready` | `boolean` | Whether the first refresh has finished, whatever its outcome, as `/readyz` reports. |
| `live` | `boolean` | Whether a refresh has started within `drift.interval` + `drift.timeout` + 1 minute, as `/livez` reports. |
| `schedule` | [`Schedule`](#schedule) | The refreshes' schedule, and how they went. |
| `netbox` | [`NetBoxState`](#netboxstate) | NetBox's state, as of the last refresh. |
| `tracing` | [`Tracing`](#tracing) | Where the service's spans are exported. |

### `Schedule`

The refreshes' schedule, and how they went.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `interval_seconds` | `number` (`double`) | The time from the start of one refresh to the start of the next, `drift.interval`. |
| `timeout_seconds` | `number` (`double`) | How long a refresh may take, `drift.timeout`. |
| `last_refresh` | [`Refresh`](#refresh), or null | The last refresh that finished, or null before the first. |
| `last_complete_refresh` | `string` (`date-time`), or null | When the last complete refresh finished, or null. |
| `next_refresh` | `string` (`date-time`), or null | When the next refresh starts, or null while one runs. |
| `refreshes` | [`RefreshCounts`](#refreshcounts) | The refreshes that finished since the service started, by outcome. |

### `Refresh`

A refresh that finished.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `started` | `string` (`date-time`) | When the refresh started. |
| `finished` | `string` (`date-time`) | When the refresh finished. |
| `duration_seconds` | `number` (`double`) | How long the refresh took. |
| `outcome` | `complete`, `incomplete`, or `failed` | `complete` if NetBox and every group's primary were read, `incomplete` if a primary couldn't be, and `failed` if NetBox couldn't be, or the refresh ran out of time. |
| `error` | `string`, or null | Why a failed refresh failed: NetBox's error, or the timeout's. Null otherwise. A group's error is with the group. |

### `RefreshCounts`

The refreshes that finished since the service started, by outcome.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `complete` | `integer` (`int64`) | Refreshes that read NetBox and every group's primary. |
| `incomplete` | `integer` (`int64`) | Refreshes that couldn't read a group's primary. |
| `failed` | `integer` (`int64`) | Refreshes that couldn't read NetBox, or ran out of time. |

### `NetBoxState`

NetBox's state, as of the last refresh.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `url` | `string` (`uri`) | NetBox's URL, `netbox.url`. |
| `up` | `boolean`, or null | Whether the last refresh could read NetBox, or null before the first. |
| `error` | `string`, or null | Why NetBox couldn't be read, or null. |

### `Tracing`

Where the service's spans are exported.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `exported` | `boolean` | Whether spans are exported, which they are when `otlp.endpoint` is set. |
| `endpoint` | `string`, or null | The OTLP collector's endpoint, `otlp.endpoint`, or null. |
| `protocol` | [`OTLPProtocol`](#otlpprotocol), or null | The OTLP protocol, `otlp.protocol`, or null. |

### `OTLPProtocol`

An OTLP protocol.

One of `http/protobuf`, or `grpc`.

### `DriftPolicy`

What nbpdns does about a zone's drift: `report` reports it, `enforce` reports it and, from M13, corrects it, and `ignore` doesn't compare the zone.

One of `enforce`, `report`, or `ignore`.

### `ServerGroup`

A PowerDNS server group, with its last-known state. The counts are as of `last_success`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The group's name, its stable ID. |
| `primary_url` | `string` (`uri`) | The URL of the group's primary's PowerDNS API. |
| `views` | array of `string` | The NetBox views whose zones the group serves. |
| `drift_policy` | [`DriftPolicy`](#driftpolicy) | What nbpdns does about a zone's drift: `report` reports it, `enforce` reports it and, from M13, corrects it, and `ignore` doesn't compare the zone. |
| `status` | `ok`, `failed`, or `unknown` | `ok` if the last refresh that tried the group's primary read it, `failed` if it couldn't, and `unknown` before any did. |
| `error` | `string`, or null | Why the primary couldn't be read, or null. |
| `last_success` | `string` (`date-time`), or null | When the group was last read and compared, or null if it never was. |
| `counts` | [`ZoneCounts`](#zonecounts), or null | The group's zones by state, as of `last_success`, or null if it was never read. |
| `problem_count` | `integer` (`int64`), or null | How many problems normalization worked around in either side's data, as of `last_success`, or null. `nbpdns drift` lists them. |
| `warning_count` | `integer` (`int64`), or null | How many problems with the configuration or NetBox's data the comparison worked around, as of `last_success`, or null. `nbpdns drift` lists them. |

### `ZoneCounts`

A server group's zones, by state.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `in_sync` | `integer` (`int64`) | Zones that the primary serves as NetBox says. |
| `drift` | `integer` (`int64`) | Zones whose RRsets differ. |
| `missing` | `integer` (`int64`) | Active NetBox zones that the primary doesn't serve. |
| `inactive_in_netbox` | `integer` (`int64`) | NetBox zones that aren't active, which the primary still serves. |
| `ignored` | `integer` (`int64`) | Zones whose drift policy is `ignore`, which aren't compared. |
| `unmanaged` | `integer` (`int64`) | Zones on the primary that NetBox doesn't assign to the group. They aren't drift. |

### `PageLinks`

The links of a page of a list (Zalando [248]).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `self` | `string` (`uri`) | This page's absolute URL. |
| `next` | `string` (`uri`), or null | The next page's absolute URL, or null on the last page. |

### `ServerGroupPage`

One page of the server groups, with its links.

The fields of [`PageLinks`](#pagelinks), and:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of [`ServerGroup`](#servergroup) | The page's server groups. |

### `ZoneState`

A zone's state: `in_sync` if the primary serves it as NetBox says, `drift` if its RRsets differ, `missing` if the primary doesn't serve an active NetBox zone, `inactive_in_netbox` if the primary serves a zone that isn't active in NetBox, `ignored` if its drift policy is `ignore`, and `unmanaged` if the primary serves a zone that NetBox doesn't assign to the group.

One of `in_sync`, `drift`, `missing`, `inactive_in_netbox`, `ignored`, or `unmanaged`.

### `Zone`

A zone of a server group, as of the group's last successful read.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `zone` | `string` | The zone's absolute name, with its final dot. |
| `view` | `string`, or null | The zone's NetBox view, or null for an unmanaged zone, which NetBox doesn't have. |
| `policy` | [`DriftPolicy`](#driftpolicy), or null | The zone's drift policy, or null for an unmanaged zone. |
| `state` | [`ZoneState`](#zonestate) | A zone's state: `in_sync` if the primary serves it as NetBox says, `drift` if its RRsets differ, `missing` if the primary doesn't serve an active NetBox zone, `inactive_in_netbox` if the primary serves a zone that isn't active in NetBox, `ignored` if its drift policy is `ignore`, and `unmanaged` if the primary serves a zone that NetBox doesn't assign to the group. |
| `netbox_serial` | `integer` (`int64`), or null | The zone's SOA serial in NetBox, or null. Serials aren't compared. |
| `powerdns_serial` | `integer` (`int64`), or null | The zone's SOA serial on the primary, or null if it doesn't serve the zone. |
| `change_count` | `integer` (`int64`) | How many of the zone's RRsets differ, which `changes` lists. |
| `rrset_count` | `integer` (`int64`), or null | How many RRsets with active records NetBox defines for the zone, which `rrsets` lists, as of NetBox's last successful read, or null if NetBox has no active zone of that name in the group's views. |

### `ChangeKind`

How an RRset differs: `missing` if NetBox has it and the primary doesn't serve it, `extra` if the primary serves it and NetBox doesn't have it, and `changed` if its values or TTL differ.

One of `missing`, `extra`, or `changed`.

| `netbox` | [`Side`](#side), or null | The RRset as NetBox has it, or null if NetBox doesn't. |
| `powerdns` | [`Side`](#side), or null | The RRset as the primary serves it, or null if it doesn't. |

### `NetBoxEvent`

A NetBox webhook's event, as NetBox 4.7 sends it without a body template: what happened to an object, the object, and the request that made the change. nbpdns reads only the fields below, and ignores the rest.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `event` | `string` | What happened to the object, such as `created`, `updated` or `deleted`. |
| `timestamp` | `string` (`date-time`) | When it happened. |
| `object_type` | `string` | The object's type. nbpdns reads `netbox_dns.record`, `netbox_dns.zone` and `netbox_dns.view`, and ignores the others. |
| `request` | [`NetBoxRequest`](#netboxrequest), or null | The NetBox request that made the change, or null if none did. |
| `data` | `object` | The object, as NetBox's API serializes it: after the change, or before it, for a deletion. A record's has its `zone`, with the zone's `id`, `name` and `view`, and a zone's has its `id`, `name` and `view`, each view with its `id` and `name`. |
| `snapshots` | [`NetBoxSnapshots`](#netboxsnapshots), or null | The object's fields around the change, with related objects as their IDs. |

### `NetBoxRequest`

A NetBox request, as its webhooks describe it.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` (`uuid`) | NetBox's ID for the request, which every event it causes shares. |
| `user` | `string` | The name of the user who made the request. |

### `NetBoxSnapshots`

An object's fields before and after a change.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `prechange` | `object`, or null | The fields before the change: null for a creation, and for some updates that the DNS plugin makes itself. A renamed zone's has its old `name`, and a moved zone's its old `view` ID, as a moved record's has its old `zone` ID. |
| `postchange` | `object`, or null | The fields after the change, or null for a deletion. |
